limits: Local ASGI transport, no TCP; warmed resident models; wall time includes server queue, JSON and routing. Client concurrency wait is excluded from per-request latency. Small tail sample; uncontrolled workstation load. Synthetic timing is not model throughput. Nearest-rank percentiles. Real Agent calls count the predict_batch boundary (system_one delegates there); agent_requested_states counts states entering that API, not hardware rows. Real-checkpoint forward calls/rows count the Torch model forward pre-hook, including retry attempts. Synthetic calls count the fixture's controlled cost chunks.
